name: Kuzu Oyaji to Wakarerarenai Haha o Aiyoku Ryakudatsu ~Semarare, Aisare, Netorareru~
original_name: クズ親父と別れられない母を愛欲略奪～迫られ、愛され、寝取られる～
source:
With my mother "Shinobu", we are living a fulfilling life together.

She is reliable and has a stable income, so our life is not difficult. While I respect my mother, I also see her as a woman and find her attractive, but I suppress my lust as best as I can.

However, my mother is blind only to "that man". As soon as she sees him, she shows her womanly expression. When "that man" comes home, he holds my mother in his arms, regardless of whether I am there or not.

They show off like that as if to humiliate me, so my anger finally explodes, and in order to make "Shinobu" my own, I......

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1214732]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
我与母亲“Shinobu”一起，过着充实的生活。

她可靠，收入稳定，因此我们生活无虞。我尊敬母亲，也把她当作一名女性，觉得她很有魅力，却始终竭力压抑自己的欲望。

然而，母亲唯独对“那个男人”盲目。一见到他，她便露出女人的神情。每当“那个男人”回家，无论我在不在场，他都会将母亲搂入怀中。
